crossRefs.note: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, “Please notice how this man seeks mischief; for he…
lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
But he said, “As Yahweh lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.
When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for…
When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in…
The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper…

people.name: Naaman
people.line: Aramean commander healed of leprosy by Elisha.

translations.web: Naaman said, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid them on two of his servants; and they carried them before him.
translations.bsb: But Naaman insisted, “Please, take two talents.” And he urged Gehazi to accept them. Then he tied up two talents of silver in two bags along with two sets of clothing and gave them to two of his servants, who carried them ahead of Gehazi.
translations.kjv: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.
translations.asv: And Naaman said, Be pleased to take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of raiment, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.
